comments.body: T-001 — Implement the public counting core is completed on phase/1-named-file-baseline at commit 57234b333e533d6bd606d3c5dda7275cf74ddacf. Immutable public TextStats and count_text implement Unicode word, CR/LF/CRLF, trailing-terminator and BOM semantics. Verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 6 tests during the preceding synchronization attempt; TASKS records focused and full discovery passing 6 tests. Completion is reconciled in docs/dev/TASKS.md and durably committed. This is a verified task checkpoint on the phase branch; milestone/phase remain incomplete and no integration into main is claimed.
